thread:
Aisha Rahman: Quick intake — new model 'bridgewire-7b' landed in open repo. Request: do a prioritized bring-up for hosting + quant experiments + catalog entry. Need quick answers on regressions and perf before we enable in hosted catalog.

Marco Li: timeline? we have a slot on infra next week but need signal on priority.

Aisha Rahman: Targeting canary next Wed. Priority: 1) safety/regression smoke 2) int8/qat experiments 3) latency/QPS benchmark + cost delta 4) catalog metadata + docs PR 5) announcement plan. If we can't meet parity on quality, hold off on public listing.

Devon Park: Started PTQ runs on rtx-a100 pool — quick notes: int8-ptq w/ per-channel scale reduced memory by ~45% and throughput +1.9x for 4-token batches. Initial evals: MMLU-ish micro suite looks within 0.6 point of fp16 on avg, but LLM-judge prompts show a few hallucination classes increased (short factual recall).

Devon Park: Paste config I used: 
```json
{
  "model": "bridgewire-7b",
  "quant": "int8_ptq",
  "calib_dataset": "1k-pairs-evalset",
  "per_channel": true,
  "optimization": "kv-cache-friendly"
}
```

Marco Li: Nice. Can you run a quick eval against our production regressions set (regressions-v2, ~500 prompts) and post diffs? We need per-prompt deltas.

Devon Park: Will run tonight, dropping results to the /tmp bucket and linking. Expect CSV with columns: prompt_id, fp16_score, int8_score, delta.

Nadia Ortiz: Heads-up on announcement: if we flip to catalog public, marketing wants a short blurb + perf table (latency/cost/quality). Do not post until Docs PR merged and SLO guardrails in Console are green.

Lina (product): Acceptance criteria from product: no more than 1.5% aggregate quality drop on core prompts, 20% cost improvement target for int8 relative to fp16, and 95th p99 latency within 1.25x of current 7b baseline. Also require rollout plan with canary + automated rollback.

Aisha Rahman: OK — checklist I'm using for this thread: 
- [ ] run regressions-v2 on fp16 vs int8 and attach per-prompt diffs
- [ ] perf bench: throughput (tokens/sec), p50/p95/p99 latency, and cost per 1M tokens
- [ ] safety/sensitive tests run (toxicity and PII recall)
- [ ] produce model catalog entry draft (fields: name, family, sizes, recommended config, quant profiles, allowed use-cases, license, caveats)
- [ ] docs PR for quickstart + example calls + warning about known regressions
- [ ] schedule announcement and release notes after docs + PR merge

Marco Li: For catalog entry, suggest adding a "fallback" recommended variant in case int8 fails (e.g., bridgewire-7b-fp16) and a suggested autoscale config: 
```
preferred_variant: int8_ptq
fallback_variant: fp16
min_instances: 2
burst_policy: allow-5s
```

Devon Park: Regression run complete, uploaded: gs://redwood-model-evals/bridgewire/1778067000/regressions.csv. Summary: 7 out of 500 prompts exceeded delta thresh (>=3pts drop) — details in CSV. Overall avg delta -0.4.

Aisha Rahman: Can someone paste the perf numbers?

Devon Park: Perf (rtx-a100, batch 4): fp16: 420 tok/s, int8_ptq: 790 tok/s. p95 latency fp16 120ms -> int8 150ms (so p95 1.25x). Cost estimate: int8 ~48% of fp16.

Nadia Ortiz: Good. Marketing can draft announcement if docs PR ready by Friday. Where should we put the blurb? slack/announcements or growth?

Lina (product): Please route announcement to #announcements and tag Sales + Enterprise when we enable dedicated. Keep messaging: "reduced cost with comparable quality" and an explicit note: "Some edge-case factual recall regressions observed; recommended fallback is fp16 variant."

Aisha Rahman: I'll open the model-catalog PR after we decide recommended quant profiles and write the docs quickstart. PR link will be posted here. Devon — can you triage the 7 bad prompts into actionable categories (prompt tweak vs quant artifact)?

Devon Park: On it. Early glance: 3 are numerical recall, 2 are instruction-following truncation, 2 are hallucination. I'll annotate and propose mitigations (prompt pre- and post-processing; re-calibration for those token ranges).

deploy-bot: deployment start: bridgewire-7b-int8_ptq -> canary namespace (job id: dj-7831). Logs: warmup complete, 10 requests sampled. No errors.

Aisha Rahman: Plan of record: finish regression triage today, docs PR by EOD Thu, perf follow-up and autoscale suggested config by Fri, then canary open to hosting team next Mon. If any regression >3pt persists after mitigations, hold public catalog listing.

Marco Li: I'll reserve infra slot Mon for canary traffic.

Nadia Ortiz: I'll coordinate announcement draft and hold until final sign-off. :thumbsup:

Lina (product): Thanks everyone — please update the checklist in the PR and tag me for approval.

Aisha Rahman: Thanks — closing loop here.
